seo.description: Aikido for adults and children in Lisbon: Benfica, Lumiar and Encarnação. Classes with Pablo Durán, 5th Dan Aikikai.

hero.tagline: Aikido for adults and children. A non-competitive practice grounded in attention, balance and relationship.

practice.label: 01 · The mountain
paragraphs: Like climbing a mountain, practice looks for no shortcuts. We repeat the movement, observe and adjust.
Technique teaches us to receive force without opposing it directly.

resumen: Dojo da Luz is a non-profit association that teaches Aikido in Lisbon, with classes in Benfica, Lumiar and Encarnação.
Classes at Dojo da Luz are led by Pablo Durán, 5th Dan Aikikai trained at the Hombu Dojo in Tokyo, and are open to adults, children and teenagers aged 5 to 17.
Aikido at Dojo da Luz is practised without competition: no previous experience is needed to start and the trial class costs €5.
